prudential-singapore-senior-data-enginee.title: Prudential (Singapore) — Senior Manager, Cloud Economics and Intelligence (Data Architecture and Solutioning)
prudential-singapore-senior-data-enginee.problem: Prudential’s Global Technology Infrastructure lacked application-level cost attribution — spend was visible at project level but not traceable to business applications. The Azure Databricks environment also lacked enforced governance — ambiguous lineage, inconsistent dev/ops separation, and thin documentation.
prudential-singapore-senior-data-enginee.role: Senior Manager, Cloud Economics and Intelligence (Data Architecture and Solutioning), Global Technology Infrastructure.
prudential-singapore-senior-data-enginee.decision: For cost attribution: an attestation and mapping layer that cross-references cloud projects against enterprise application records. For Databricks governance: Unity Catalog, Declarative Asset Bundles with enforced tagging, serverless execution, and medallion patterns — with lineage treated as a first-class artifact.
prudential-singapore-senior-data-enginee.outcome: New-hire ramp 6→4 weeks (~33%) after documentation standards; lineage ambiguities down ~40%; BigQuery framework query costs ~20% via partitioning; first actionable app-level cost view across multi-region operations.
prudential-singapore-senior-data-enginee.evidence: Public role on LinkedIn. CEI internals are not published.

sph-media-lead-data-engineer.title: SPH Media — Lead Data Engineer
sph-media-lead-data-engineer.problem: Audience ingestion and analytics needed a resilient, maintainable AWS home after Composer-era pipelines.
sph-media-lead-data-engineer.decision: Idempotent social ingestion; Composer → Glue/Athena/S3; documentation standards and mentoring.
sph-media-lead-data-engineer.outcome: Cost-saving, resilient pipelines for audience engagement and app backends; analytics platform on AWS.

stb-data-engineer-applied-ml.title: Singapore Tourism Board — production ML for arrival forecasts
stb-data-engineer-applied-ml.problem: Tourism arrival forecasts lived in data-science workflows that operations could not run as a production service.
stb-data-engineer-applied-ml.decision: Deploy models on AWS SageMaker with vendor NCS; add CI/CD for production ML; run the team’s ingestion and processing pipelines.
stb-data-engineer-applied-ml.outcome: Arrival forecasts served from SageMaker with a repeatable deploy path.

linkedin-analytics-databricks.outcome: Give a professional a first-party LinkedIn analytics workspace they can run themselves — from export to dashboard — without waiting on vendor reporting.
linkedin-analytics-databricks.scope: Public tutorial series documenting the end-to-end data product for educational reuse.

metis-mta-edaproject.outcome: Point a campaign toward the stations where footfall actually concentrates, using public turnstile counts.
metis-mta-edaproject.scope: Exploratory analysis of NYC MTA station usage and a placement recommendation.

metis-animelist-score-prediction.outcome: Surface which titles the crowd over- or under-rates, so a catalog decision is not just a raw score.
metis-animelist-score-prediction.scope: Scraping, feature engineering, regression, and bias analysis on MyAnimeList scores.

metis-global-fishing-watch.outcome: Separate fishing from other maritime traffic at F1 0.90 and AUC 0.98, so activity can be monitored rather than inspected by hand.

metis-fake-news-detection.outcome: Route dubious claims to review instead of treating every statement as equal — automated fact-checking on the LIAR dataset.
metis-fake-news-detection.scope: NLP, topic modeling, and word embeddings for claim classification.

metis-generative-poetry-lstm.outcome: Let a reader generate original verse in the browser, as a small creative product rather than a training-loop write-up.
metis-generative-poetry-lstm.scope: LSTM text generation with a Flask and PostgreSQL path to the page.

skillup-mtech-capstone.decision: CSP, fuzzy logic, and RAG explainability for a personalised learning-path coach.
skillup-mtech-capstone.outcome: Explainable course recommendations operators can inspect.
